summary: Initialize the universal exact-2n effective-switch prove-or-refute goal, separate maximizer and minimizer claims, an endpoint-count reduction, exact obligations, and five mechanism-distinct routes.

node.title: Endpoint norming constants determine the exact zero and switch count
node.statement: For every rho in K_R, orient and weighted-L2 normalize u_n,u_{n+1}, put c=sqrt(lambda_n/lambda_{n+1}), q_0=u_{n+1}'(0)/u_n'(0), and q_1=u_{n+1}'(1)/u_n'(1). Then F_n has exactly 2n-2+1_{q_0>c}+1_{q_1<-c} distinct interior zeros. If rho is a global extremizer, every one of these simple zeros is an effective switch, so rho has exactly 2n switches if and only if q_0>c and q_1<-c.

node.title: Maximizer endpoint norming rigidity
node.statement: For every R>1 and integer n>=2, every global maximizer rho_* of D_n on K_R satisfies u_{n+1}'(0)/u_n'(0)>sqrt(lambda_n/lambda_{n+1}) and u_{n+1}'(1)/u_n'(1)<-sqrt(lambda_n/lambda_{n+1}) for consistently oriented weighted-L2 normalized consecutive eigenfunctions.

node.title: Minimizer endpoint norming rigidity
node.statement: For every R>1 and integer n>=2, every global minimizer rho_* of D_n on K_R satisfies u_{n+1}'(0)/u_n'(0)>sqrt(lambda_n/lambda_{n+1}) and u_{n+1}'(1)/u_n'(1)<-sqrt(lambda_n/lambda_{n+1}) for consistently oriented weighted-L2 normalized consecutive eigenfunctions.

node.title: Every adjacent-gap maximizer has exactly 2n switches
node.statement: For every R>1 and integer n>=2, every global maximizer of D_n on K_R has exactly 2n effective switches after adjacent equal-value blocks are merged.

node.title: Every adjacent-gap minimizer has exactly 2n switches
node.statement: For every R>1 and integer n>=2, every global minimizer of D_n on K_R has exactly 2n effective switches after adjacent equal-value blocks are merged.

node.title: Universal exact-2n effective-switch conjecture
node.statement: For every R>1, every integer n>=2, and every global maximizer or global minimizer rho_* of D_n on K_R, rho_* has exactly 2n effective switches after adjacent equal-value blocks are merged.

node.title: Nodal-cell endpoint limits reduce exact switch count to two norming inequalities
node.statement: CLM-NGE2-FINITE-REDUCTION, quotient monotonicity, endpoint limits, and simple-zero saturation imply CLM-NGE2-ENDPOINT-COUNT.
unresolved_obligations: Prove the exact level-crossing count on first, middle, and last nodal cells, including equality cases.
Prove that each simple switching-function zero is an effective switch at every global extremizer.

node.title: Global maximality forces both endpoint norming inequalities
node.statement: The accepted finite reduction and a valid endpoint-variation or global comparison argument imply CLM-NGE2-MAX-ENDPOINT-RIGIDITY.
unresolved_obligations: Derive strict endpoint slope inequalities for every global maximizer, or certify a counterexample.

node.title: Global minimality forces both endpoint norming inequalities
node.statement: The accepted finite reduction and a valid endpoint-variation or global comparison argument imply CLM-NGE2-MIN-ENDPOINT-RIGIDITY.
unresolved_obligations: Derive strict endpoint slope inequalities for every global minimizer, or certify a counterexample.

node.title: Endpoint count and maximizer rigidity imply exact 2n switches
node.statement: CLM-NGE2-ENDPOINT-COUNT and CLM-NGE2-MAX-ENDPOINT-RIGIDITY imply CLM-NGE2-EXACT2N-MAX.
unresolved_obligations: Establish both premises in the full quantifier scope.

node.title: Endpoint count and minimizer rigidity imply exact 2n switches
node.statement: CLM-NGE2-ENDPOINT-COUNT and CLM-NGE2-MIN-ENDPOINT-RIGIDITY imply CLM-NGE2-EXACT2N-MIN.
unresolved_obligations: Establish both premises in the full quantifier scope.

node.title: Maximizer and minimizer exact-switch claims imply the universal claim
node.statement: CLM-NGE2-EXACT2N-MAX and CLM-NGE2-EXACT2N-MIN imply CLM-NGE2-EXACT2N-ALL.
unresolved_obligations: Resolve both universal subclaims, or refute the combined claim by a verified witness to either failure.

node.title: Prove or refute universal exact 2n effective switches
node.statement: Determine whether CLM-NGE2-EXACT2N-ALL is true in CTX-DEFAULT, while separately classifying the maximizer and minimizer subclaims as far as viable routes permit.
node.quantifier_contract: For every real R>1, every integer n>=2, and every global maximizer or minimizer rho_* of D_n on K_R, the effective switch count after merging adjacent equal-value blocks is exactly 2n.
boundary_cases: n=2 and both endpoint nodal cells.
R approaches 1 from above and arbitrary large finite R.
Endpoint equality in the norming inequalities, reflection pairs, nonuniqueness, and inactive switching-function zeros.
completion_criteria: A content-hashed proof or refutation package has no unresolved obligations and passes independent definition, logic, boundary, and adversarial audits.
An approved proposal is deterministically merged and the post-merge trusted closure or verified refutation resolves the target.
non_completion_conditions: Finite scans, local stationary designs, or a switching-function zero count without a global extremizer certificate do not count.
A candidate proof, self-review, or unmerged proposal does not count.

node.title: Exact nodal-cell count and effective-switch equivalence
node.statement: Prove the exact endpoint-count formula and the zero-to-effective-switch implication required by INF-NGE2-ENDPOINT-COUNT.
node.formal_statement: Show that all middle nodal cells contribute exactly two zeros, the first and last cells contribute the stated endpoint indicators, equality contributes no interior extra zero, and every simple zero changes the saturated endpoint value at an extremizer.
discharge_criteria: Audit one-sided quotient limits at both Dirichlet endpoints and every interior pole.
Separate zero count from effective switch count and prove the latter using the correct maximum/minimum saturation laws.

node.title: Endpoint rigidity for every maximizer
node.statement: Prove or refute the two strict endpoint norming inequalities for every global maximizer.
node.formal_statement: For each global maximizer, prove q_0>c and q_1<-c, or produce a certified global maximizer violating at least one inequality.
discharge_criteria: Cover every maximizer rather than one selected branch.
Certify strictness, endpoint normalization, and full-box global optimality.

node.title: Endpoint rigidity for every minimizer
node.statement: Prove or refute the two strict endpoint norming inequalities for every global minimizer.
node.formal_statement: For each global minimizer, prove q_0>c and q_1<-c, or produce a certified global minimizer violating at least one inequality.
discharge_criteria: Cover every minimizer rather than one selected branch.
Certify strictness, endpoint normalization, and full-box global optimality.

node.title: Continuum-global certificate for a fewer-switch candidate
node.statement: Any proposed counterexample must certify global extremality in the full measurable box and an exact effective switch count below 2n.
node.formal_statement: For explicit R,n,rho_*, prove rho_* is a global maximizer or minimizer over all K_R and has fewer than 2n effective switches under DEF-BANGBANG-SWITCH-COUNT.
discharge_criteria: Verify every premise and exclude all admissible competitors, not only a finite grid or fixed topology.
Bind exact or interval-certified artifacts and a proof bridge.

node.title: Endpoint norming-constant rigidity route
node.statement: Reduce the exact switch count to endpoint slope ratios and seek a global-optimality inequality forcing both strict signs.
node.method_family: Wronskian quotient limits, norming constants, endpoint perturbations, and global comparison
node.deliverable_contract: A complete endpoint-count lemma plus a proof/refutation of at least one endpoint-rigidity subclaim, or one exact remaining obstruction.
falsification_tests: Search stationary and optimized bang-bang designs with q_0<=c or q_1>=-c.
Audit equality cases and reflection-asymmetric extrema.
node.expected_bottleneck: Global extremality gives interior needle conditions but no obvious endpoint slope inequality.

node.title: Certified fewer-switch counterexample route
node.statement: Enumerate finite-block topologies allowed by the 2n theorem, discover fewer-switch winners, and seek a continuum-global certificate.
node.method_family: Transfer matrices, topology enumeration, interval optimization, and global comparison
node.deliverable_contract: A verified counterexample with every premise checked, or a bounded computation report with the exact missing proof bridge.
falsification_tests: Reject local optima, grid artifacts, missed narrow blocks, eigenvalue misindexing, and null-set switch inflation.
node.expected_bottleneck: Certifying optimality over the continuum union of all block topologies.

node.title: Small-contrast continuation route
node.statement: Analyze the first-order optimizer at R=1 and continue its 2n transverse switches for R>1 small.
node.method_family: Small-contrast expansion, transversality, implicit-function continuation, and uniform remainder bounds
node.deliverable_contract: A rigorous exact-2n theorem on a nonempty interval 1<R<1+epsilon_n, a transition mechanism, or the first uniformity obstruction.
falsification_tests: Compute all first-order switching zeros and check simplicity and global sign selection.
node.expected_bottleneck: Uniform global optimality against every measurable competitor.

node.title: Large-contrast localization route
node.statement: Use high-contrast localization and decoupling to compare exact-2n and fewer-switch extremal topologies.
node.method_family: Large-R asymptotics, interval decoupling, nodal localization, and certified remainder comparison
node.deliverable_contract: A rigorous asymptotic theorem, a finite-R certified counterexample, or the exact unclosed remainder estimate.
falsification_tests: Track vanishing block lengths, endpoint cells, and competing reflection topologies.
node.expected_bottleneck: Turning an R=infinity pattern into a strict statement at finite R.

node.title: Adversarial computation and literature route for exact switches
node.statement: Independently attack the universal claim by smallest-index optimization, endpoint-ratio scans, stronger-conjecture failures, and primary-source searches.
node.method_family: Independent numerical falsification, boundary auditing, and alternate-terminology literature search
node.deliverable_contract: A verified source theorem, a counterexample candidate with full diagnostics, or a calibrated no-counterexample report with limitations.
falsification_tests: n=2, R downarrow 1, large R, maximizer versus minimizer, symmetry breaking, endpoint equality, and missed narrow cells.
node.expected_bottleneck: Numerical globality and incomplete access to older optimization literature.
